items.q: How would you keep a long-running chat within budget?
items.a: Keep the last few turns verbatim, fold older turns into a **running summary** with a dedicated prompt, and move durable facts to **long-term memory**. Summarize only when over a token threshold, and drop old turns only after the summary succeeds.
items.trap: Summarizing on every turn: it adds a call each time and the summary drifts.

items.q: What can go wrong with summaries?
items.a: **Lost details** (exact numbers, code), **drift** as summaries of summaries pile up, and the extra **cost** and latency of the summary call. Mitigate with a clear keep-list, a length limit and long-term facts for what must be exact.
items.trap: Treating a summary as a perfect record.
